## Validation and release gates

- [ ] Offline smoke tests pass
- [ ] No credentials, restricted data, generated large files or private metadata committed
- [ ] Data source, units, uncertainty and missingness are explicit
- [ ] New model compared to meaningful baselines on exactly matched cohorts
- [ ] No test-set tuning or future-data leakage
- [ ] Results include **failures** and limitations
- [ ] README/docs/CITATION and scientific readiness labels updated when necessary
- [ ] Dashboard does not imply forecast validation if gates are blocked
